verdict.rationale: GitLab's docs say its REST API is described in an OpenAPI 3.0 spec, autogenerated from the API code, with the raw spec file available in the GitLab monorepo (doc/api/openapi/openapi_v2.yaml). An interactive documentation and request tool reportedly covers every endpoint. missing for 10: a dedicated download or served spec endpoint (the raw spec lives only as a monorepo file), and independent or hands-on confirmation that the spec is complete and usable by tooling.
